outcome: failure of induction of labor (defined as cesarean section)
cohort: 150 women undergoing induction of labor at a tertiary care maternity.
finding: Multivariate analysis identified posterior cervical angle (threshold 105 degrees) and fetal head-perineum distance (threshold 55mm) as independent predictors of failure of labor induction.
mod_finding: The study identified specific ultrasound parameters (posterior cervical angle and fetal head-perineum distance) that independently predict the likelihood of requiring a cesarean section after labor induction.
